name: Awning and accessory repair
summary: Torn fabric, a bent arm or an awning that won’t roll out: we repair or replace awnings and broken accessories.
includes: Repairing awnings that are torn, bent or won’t open or close
Replacing the awning fabric or the whole awning
bring: The keys to the unit and any compartment locks
A photo of the damage, if it happened on the road

faq.q: My awning fabric is torn. Do I need a whole new awning?
faq.a: Not always. Often the fabric can be replaced on the existing arms. We look at it and tell you which makes sense.

faq.q: Do you work on electric awnings?
faq.confirm: Does the shop repair electric (powered) awnings?

faq.a: It depends on the awning and the damage, so we quote after we’ve inspected it.

confirm: Which accessories does this cover (steps, ladders, vents, covers, hitches)?
